Ranid_Saltatory_Chassis.description: A compact, highly specialized anuran chassis entirely devoted to shock absorption and anchoring massive hind limb musculature. Features an inflexible spine and fused urostyle, trading rotational flexibility for extreme forward-launching biomechanics.

Caudate_Elongated_Frame.description: A long, cartilaginous salamander-like frame built for undulating movement across mud and undergrowth. It is incredibly flexible, allowing the creature to slip through impossible crevices and distribute impact force evenly.

Gymnophiona_Serpentine_Core.description: A deeply annulated, bullet-shaped core completely lacking anchor points for limbs. Resembling a gigantic earthworm or blind snake, it is forged from dense muscle specifically adapted for subterranean, subterranean ram-burrowing.
